notes: Bodypack transmitter for the EW-DX digital wireless system, worn on-body, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Standard EW-DX SK uses a locking 3.5mm TRS audio input (mic/line/instrument via adapter cables); a separate SKU variant, "EW-DX SK 3-PIN", instead uses a 3-pin locking connector (LEMO-style) in place of the 3.5mm jack — only one audio input is fitted per unit, not both. Power comes from 2x user-replaceable AA batteries (1.5V) or the optional BA 70 Li-ion pack; there is no external AC/DC power-input jack. The unit also has proprietary pogo-pin charging contacts on the underside for docking in the CHG 70N charger — this is not a cabled connector and does not map to any connector id in the given list, so it is omitted as a port (noted here instead). The antenna is a fixed/integrated wire antenna, not a connector, so it is not listed as a port. No USB, network, or other digital ports are present on the transmitter itself (Bluetooth/BLE is wireless only, used for control/monitoring). Frequency-band variants (Q1-9, R1-9, S1-10, etc.) do not affect physical I/O.

ports.name: Audio In (locking 3.5 mm)
ports.note: Locking 3.5mm TRS jack for lavalier/headset mic (electret bias 2.0-4.35V) or instrument via adapter cable; present on the standard EW-DX SK SKU. The separate EW-DX SK 3-PIN SKU has a 3-pin locking connector here instead.
